the_real_path: PROVEN, AND THIS IS THE FIRST TIME. Every earlier Room sign-in on this appliance reached scd through the resolve socket with portald bypassed; this one came from a real device through the real captive portal. At 14:59:30 the device's own connectivity probe (GET connectivitycheck.gstatic.com/generate_204 from 192.168.77.105) was redirected 302 and the portal served /api/auth-methods. At 14:59:54 the guest submitted POST http://portal.stayconnect.local/auth/pms/phase3 - portald answered 200 in 2.227s, having forwarded to scd, which logged POST /v1/phase3/auth/pms/resolve 200 (1.651s), then 'phase3 auth: access granted and enforced', then POST /v1/phase3/auth/pms/grant 200 (506ms). At 14:59:55 the device was served /success?s=5feee27d-2100-4140-9815-aa3584dd7ec0. NO GUEST-FACING PMS SELECTOR EXISTS: the portal offers voucher and pms with mode room_any, so the guest supplies a room and the system resolves the single ACTIVE interface itself.
